name: Tempest
title: tempestdx.com
payoff: Ships code fast with managed portal
shortDescription: Tempest is a fully-managed developer portal designed to streamline the development process, reduce operational overhead, and ensure compliance with security standards. It is ideal for teams looking to deploy, manage, and ship quality code faster without the friction of managing infrastructure. Example use case: Software development teams can utilize Tempest to automate their deployment pipelines and manage their development workflows more efficiently.
cons: May be less customizable due to managed nature
Potential dependency on a single vendor
Could be expensive for smaller teams

aiSuggestedAlternatives.name: Backstage
aiSuggestedAlternatives.reason: Open platform for building developer portals
